exact_holds.description: J4 Rule13.5.3.5-1 says insert13-3, source table says13-4.
J4 original SMPTE 1310nm Rule has no separately identified video optical contacts in four-contact Ethernet table.
J4 OM2-or-better Class3 fiber baseline differs from Class1&2 OM3.
J3 Class3 four digital/two composite differs from earlier Class1&2 eleven-contact video; no live footage.
J5 conditional GPS antenna not actual position/time.
Class3 J6 14A/2s inrush and10A nominal differ from earlier25A/15A; no device measurements.
Separate J6 Rules13.5.3.7.1-3 and -5 repeat 10A post-inrush shall.
J6 repeated Recommendations -1 and -2 carry different verification notes but remain SHOULD.
J6 Observation13.5.3.7.1-2 prints Inspection(I) but remains Observation.
J6 isolation/grounding physical conformance never independently tested.
J7 original table preamble unnumbered matching-shell-plating SHALL retained.
J7 physical Write Enable is not a software CSAPI Command or observed memory write.
J8 Class3 eleven RF contacts rather than Class1&2 nineteen; modality pixels not verified.
J9 Rule13.5.3.10-2 says25-8 insert, table and Class3 catalog say21-75.
J9 Class3 four RF contacts rather than earlier eight; actual RF links untested.
J8/J9 VSWR upper limits are physical criteria, not measured power or ISA signal strength.
J11 Rule13.5.3.12.1-1 wrongly points at later Class5 Table13.5.4.3-1 rather than Class3 native J11 table.
Class3 J11 270VDC5A/7.5A inrush differ from Class1&2 270V10A/15A.
Class3 J12/J13 original headings say Class1&2 and applicability is not silently changed.
J12 differential non-GPS vs J13 TIA232 GPS key-fill roles, no online key provisioning service.
J13 Rule13.5.3.14-5 label lacks explicit shall.
J14 Class3 two MT/48 fibers and J15 one MT/24 fibers not separate installed sensors.
J14 common reference to 13.5.2.16.1-2/-3/-4 unverified.
J14 common source method notes differ from directly printed J4 Rule13.5.3.5-3/-9 methods.
J16 nominal3.3V vs max3.5V V_BATT; ALT3.9V, 115mA each, no charge/energy evidence.
All fourteen figure pixels and modality checkbox alignment unverified.
Original external IEEE/MIL/SMPTE/VITA etc and eight C239 original native DSDM/IDL/OpenAPI files unread.
2025 S251 edition separate and C239 AppendixC restricted.
Four empirical devices have no direct test of SOSA Class3 connectors.
No adopted DIM classes/chassis/cardinality, CSAPI Profile SHALL or independent device/runtime conformance.
